Subject: Developer Café: hands-on Inference Lab + Partner podcast pilot

Hi Aisha —

Quick idea: CogForge + Redwood run a short co-branded series called 'Developer Café' — two parts:

1) A 60-minute hands-on inference lab (bring-your-own-model, instrumented prompts, live KV cache demo) for engineers.
2) A 30-minute partner podcast episode (product stories + quick tips) published as a companion piece.

Why this fits: engineers at our joint customers want actionable docs, low-friction demos, and a short thought-leadership piece they can share internally. We can seed registrants from both lists and include a follow-up notebook + sample config.

Ask: are you open to piloting this in July or early August? If yes, can you share a short partner bio and a few sample customer use-cases we can reference? I attached a draft agenda and a one-pager on sponsor tiers.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm pilot date range (July 27–Aug 6)
- Share CogForge bio + 3 use-case bullets
- Decide lead moderator (Redwood dev advocate) and CogForge co-presenter
- Confirm sponsor LOI (we'll do a light sponsor split)

Attachments: RDW-DeveloperCafe-Agenda-v3.pdf, DevCafe-sponsor-LOI.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min sync if easier.

—Laura
